$comment: Gzip bytes. Budgets sit 2% above the sizes at the time they were set; lower them as bundles shrink (bun scripts/perf/bundle.ts --update). A budget that rises needs a "why" on its entry, such as { "gzip": 290000, "why": "..." }; bun run perf:guards checks it. Targets are Plan 15 goals and are not enforced yet.

entry.why: Personal sidebar organization: Pinned Spaces, the person's groups with their menus and focus, the Worktable header menu, and saving the arrangement in the background.

root css.why: The theme defines eight recognition colors, each with solid, ink and soft values in light and dark. Docs share one reading stylesheet (document-content.css), which the saved preview needs before the app's JavaScript loads so nothing moves when a Doc opens. It replaces markdown.css and the preview overrides, and adds lists, checklists, code headers, tables, toggles, diagrams and the text color palette; controls that only appear once a Doc is interactive load with the viewer and editor instead. Setup and Getting Started add the connect rows, guide cards and progress ring.

home.why: Personal sidebar organization: Pinned Spaces, the person's groups with their menus and focus, the Worktable header menu, and saving the arrangement in the background. Shared configured agent logos, custom icons and person avatars plus full-row activity links add 1.9 KB gzip against main 9a52b0b, measured on Namespace; identity metadata uses the existing workspace response. Every page carries a small Cloud billing root that loads the payment banner only while a payment is overdue, and the invitations kept across a payment only while some wait. Sharing policy revisions reach other signed-in sessions through the existing WebSocket. Namespace CI run 39590785899 measured Home at 334.3 KB gzip, about 0.1 KB above the previous budget. Allow 0.3 KB for the event dispatch; sharing cache invalidation remains a lazy import and adds no requests to Home. Visitor review adds comment-count and paused-link entries to Pending, with one shared row and no extra chunk. Namespace measured 334670 gzip bytes, 267 bytes above the parent. Allow another 500 bytes for these entries and the lazy review panel references; request and I/O budgets are unchanged.

space.why: The welcome a new member sees in the Space they were invited to, and the Getting Started row at the top of the sidebar while the person keeps it pinned. Getting Started's own page loads only in that Space.

rich document.why: The sidebar footer shows who is signed in, with a menu for Profile, Preferences, the theme and Sign Out, and Settings groups into You, the Worktable and Support. Share-link counts now refresh at their next expiry without polling: c3416a55 measured 802.0 KB gzip on Namespace CI (run 39589556673), about 0.1 KB over the prior budget. Allow 0.3 KB for that deadline hook; the Share dialog remains lazy and document contents are not refetched. Grok integration and coding-agent logos measured 802.2 KB gzip on Namespace run 39861990588, just over the previous limit. Allow 0.5 KB for the shared platform catalog, avatar handling, delivery status and connection refresh on the existing participant event; Grok setup stays lazy and adds no document content requests. Files in Docs, behind the files preview: embeds resolve to the Space's files with the versions the Doc's page already carries, and pasted or dropped files upload into the Doc's folder. CI run on 6c6a130d measured 803.1 KB gzip, 0.4 KB over; allow 1 KB. Revisits load embedded images from the browser cache and add no requests.

html document.why: Worktable Teams: HTML documents open read-only for members with read access, and address their frame by the member's per-Space content key (Plan 16). The personal sidebar organization adds Pinned Spaces, groups and the Worktable header menu. Configured avatars and the shared version-history chooser, aligned snapshot byline and restore controls add 2.7 KB gzip against main 9a52b0b, measured on Namespace; snapshot content stays lazy and sandboxed. Every page carries a small Cloud billing root that loads the payment banner only while a payment is overdue, and the invitations kept across a payment only while some wait.
